purpose: Separate the reviewed donor inventory from actual contact-language proposals, establish a reversible shared script profile, audit every source-facing lexical input, and build a bounded first synthesis probe.

semantic_allocations: contact adam is human/person while regional lənəw remains man
contact iša is wife/female spouse while regional oxkweew remains the donor candidate for woman

orthography.combination_test_scope: Canonical contact-token sequences through length three after forbidden practical digraph inputs are rejected.

local_embedding_state.reason: Typing 72 source-facing records as donor candidates changed their fingerprints; revision propagation invalidated all 20 dependent construction, phrase, and sentence probes; and the 15 contact records are new.

limitations: Every record remains noncanonical and the contact script profile remains provisional.
The two mixed formations test traceable synthesis; they do not license a productive pattern.
The contact probe does not implement nominal paradigms, possession, full verb morphology, ordinary clause grammar, or the narrative engine.
The local vector freshness count describes the existing local checkpoint database and is not itself a language-quality evaluation.
No embedding or generative-model call was made, so this checkpoint contains no new semantic-retrieval score.
